filhos.explicacao:
Add your children here. Because they have no email and no account in the app, this is how the church knows their birthdays and builds the Children's Ministry class list.

Everything you write about them is visible only to you and to the church leadership. The birthday list shows their name and the day only — not the year, and nothing else from the record.
